evals.prompt: Create a test strategy for a high-value API feature with functional, security and performance risks.
evals.expected_output: A risk-based Master Test Plan with test levels, cases, fixtures, vectors, automation boundaries and evidence.
expectations: Includes negative, boundary and authorization cases
Defines deterministic fixtures and data handling

evals.prompt: Review an existing regression suite with flaky end-to-end tests and propose an automation improvement plan.
evals.expected_output: A diagnosis, prioritization, quarantine policy and measurable remediation plan.
expectations: Does not recommend deleting tests solely because they are slow
Uses test pyramid as a heuristic
